title: Show HN: Skill for your agent to visualize your gbrain and Obsidian
summary: A skill that enables AI agents to visualize and navigate personal knowledge bases stored in Obsidian and gbrain, allowing agents to better understand and interact with interconnected notes and information.
problem_solved: Enables AI agents to visualize and reason over interconnected personal knowledge stored across Obsidian notes and gbrain.
why_valuable: Provides agents with visual understanding of complex note relationships, improving their ability to assist with research and knowledge discovery tasks.
